content.short: Metamorph enables multiplayer interactions in a virtual world with AI characters, leveraging blockchain to boost value for creators and asset owners.
content.description: Metamorph expands opportunities for user-generated content in traditional life-simulation games by integrating blockchain technologies that reward creators and asset owners. By scaling UGC mechanics, it aims to position Metamorph as a strong competitor to the largest gaming publishers. The project also seeks to help traditional gamers recognize the value of NFT assets within games, with the goal of boosting engagement, involvement, and long-term retention.
content.meta: Metamorph lets people interact in a multiplayer virtual world with AI characters. Discover Metamorph and other Decentralized Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
